title: Venue and program badge family

location.series: Pentagram / The Public Theater case study

slide_intent: Distinguish related destinations while retaining a shared form because people need both affiliation and a specific name.
strategic_value: Circular badges can connect the theater’s different venues and activities without erasing their identities.
demonstration: Nine colored circular emblems combine perimeter names with contrasting central letters or symbols.
practical_value: Use the badge family to compare what stays fixed and what varies across sub-identities.

content_islands.name: Badge array
content_islands.spec: Arrange nine circular marks in a staggered vertical group.

content_islands.name: Internal structure
content_islands.spec: Pair each perimeter label with its central identifier and local color.
